headlines.headline: GIANNIS'S HEAT OFFENSE KEEPS CLICKING IN PRESEASON AS LEAGUE SETS OCT. 20 OPENING NIGHT
headlines.detail: Giannis Antetokounmpo scored 18 points on 8-of-13 shooting in Miami's 128-118 preseason win over New Orleans, extending a strong start after the trade that sent Tyler Herro north. The Oct. 20 opener: champion Knicks host LeBron James and the 76ers for New York's ring ceremony, while Detroit opens at home against Boston.

headlines.headline: SEAHAWKS HOST UNBEATEN 49ERS SUNDAY WITH FIRST PLACE IN THE NFC WEST ON THE LINE
headlines.detail: Seattle (3-1) and San Francisco kicked off at 4:25 p.m. ET at Lumen Field, Seattle favored by roughly 3 points with its top-ranked defense against a 49ers offense missing Nick Bosa. The game was still in progress as this brief was published.

headlines.headline: NO. 1 TEXAS STUNNED BY OKLAHOMA 27-24 ON WALK-OFF FIELD GOAL AS GEORGIA TOPPLES BAMA IN TUSCALOOSA
headlines.detail: Tate Sandell's 47-yard field goal on the final play gave Oklahoma a 27-24 upset of top-ranked Texas in the 122nd Red River Rivalry. Hours earlier, No. 2 Georgia beat No. 6 Alabama 20-17 at Bryant-Denny Stadium, Georgia's first regular-season win there since 2007.

headlines.headline: KANSAS'S TYRAN STOKES, ARKANSAS'S JORDAN SMITH JR. HEADLINE PRESEASON ALL-AMERICA BUZZ AHEAD OF NOV. 2 TIP-OFF
headlines.detail: Five-star freshmen Stokes and Smith Jr. are drawing early All-America attention as outlets release first Top 25 projections, with BartTorvik slotting Kansas No. 10 nationally. St. John's continues reshaping its rotation around guard Donnie Freeman's season-ending Achilles injury.
